parameters.name: BizTypeList
parameters.description: The list of invoicing entities to which the invoiceable objects belong.

parameters.name: EndAmount
parameters.description: The maximum amount for the query.

parameters.name: EndBizTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query based on the successful payment time. The format is yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

parameters.name: EndSearchTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query.

parameters.name: OutBizId
parameters.description: The order ID, bill ID, or contract ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sorting type. Valid values:

- 1: sorts the results by ID in descending order.

- 2: sorts the results by type in descending order, and then by ID in descending order.

- 3: sorts the results by type in ascending order, and then by ID in descending order.

parameters.name: StartAmount
parameters.description: The minimum amount for the query.

parameters.name: StartBizTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query based on the successful payment time. The format is yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

parameters.name: StartSearchTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type. Valid values:

- 1: queries objects with a negative invoiceable amount.

- 2: queries objects with a positive invoiceable amount.

- 3: queries all objects with a non-zero invoiceable amount.

- 4: queries objects with an invoiced amount greater than 0.

> If you leave this parameter empty, all objects are queried.
